fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and satire on Miami civic affairs, including Mayor/Commissioner Ev Sewell and disputes involving the Chamber of Commerce and city publicity funds; support for a campaign against drunken drivers; criticism of city manager budgeting and calls for administrative reform; discussion of Miami Beach coastal erosion and proposed bond financing; commentary on the Homestead bank failure and county deposits; advocacy for planning a major airport; local gossip columns, letters to the editor, advertisements, and sports notices including boxing bouts.
